question: What is MenuList?
answer: MenuList turns a current menu into one owner-approved public version customers can trust.
source_note: Grounded in current MenuList website positioning.

question: Does MenuList publish a menu automatically after upload?
answer: No. MenuList prepares the customer-facing version and the owner reviews before publishing.
source_note: Owner review is central to public create-menu and menu link import.

question: Can an owner start from a menu photo or PDF?
answer: Yes. MenuList supports starting from the menu the owner already has, including a photo, PDF, existing menu link, or typed menu.
source_note: Use careful language. Do not claim unsupported file families beyond current docs.

question: Can MenuList import any website or marketplace page?
answer: No. Menu link import is for public menu URLs the owner controls or has permission to import. It is not a marketplace crawler or login bypass.
source_note: High-risk because overclaiming creates security and legal risk.

question: What is the Official Business Page?
answer: It is one official public identity link for a business, with business details and a path to the menu. It is not a generic website builder.

question: What is Menu Kit?
answer: Menu Kit is a launch pack with print-ready and social-ready materials such as table tent, counter sticker, entrance poster, QR assets, story images, placement guide, staff script, and print instructions.

question: How do Digital Screens stay current?
answer: Digital Screens read from the same MenuList menu data. The owner opens a screen link on a TV or tablet and menu management stays inside MenuList.

question: Does MenuList guarantee Google ranking or AI citation?
answer: No. MenuList prepares a clearer official public source through public pages, structured data, sitemap, robots, and LLM discovery files. Search and AI systems decide what they crawl and show.

question: What is External Menu Sync?
answer: External Menu Sync sends a signed full-menu snapshot to a connected provider or developer URL after approved menu-affecting changes.
source_note: Avoid universal POS or real-time sync claims.

question: How does MenuList handle multiple locations?
answer: MenuList supports a master/outlet model where a master menu can feed outlet menus while preserving outlet-specific overrides where allowed.
source_note: Keep scope tied to implemented multi-outlet docs.

question: Can staff access be limited?
answer: Yes. MenuList has staff roles and permissions, with owner, manager, and staff defaults plus protected APIs and route/screen gates.

question: Can MenuList screenshots be used for Answerlattice marketing?
answer: Generated MenuList demo visuals can be used as generated examples. Real or routed screenshots need a founder-approved demo tenant and must not contain private owner, tenant, store, customer, or debug data.

question: How do I sign in to MenuList?
answer: Go to menulist.ai and sign in with the method connected to your account: Google, email/password, WhatsApp number/passcode, or Staff ID/passcode.

question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
answer: Use Forgot password for email accounts. Staff without email should ask the owner to reset access from Users.
source_note: Do not reveal or guess passwords.

question: Why do I see Access Denied?
answer: Your account may not have access to that store. Ask the account owner or admin to grant access.

question: How do I change an item price?
answer: Open Projects, select the menu, edit the item price, save, then check the public menu after the short cache window.

question: How do I mark an item sold out?
answer: Open the menu in Projects, turn the item's Available switch off, and save. The customer menu and dependent surfaces should stop showing it as available.

question: Why is my public menu still showing the old price?
answer: Check that the edit was saved, wait up to about 60 seconds, refresh the public menu, and confirm the correct store/menu is active. Escalate if it is still wrong.

question: Why do customers see Menu Not Found?
answer: Check that the store is active, the menu/project is active, the QR URL is correct, and any custom domain setup is complete.

question: How do I update business hours?
answer: Open Business Settings, update Working Hours, save, and wait for the public page/menu to refresh.

question: How do I show Closed Today or Opening Late?
answer: Use Temporary Status in Business Settings or mobile More, choose the status, set an expiry time, and save. It clears automatically at expiry.

question: What should I do if the digital screen is blank?
answer: Check the TV/tablet internet, copy the screen URL again from settings, confirm the menu has active items, and refresh the browser.

question: Why did my outlet not follow the master price?
answer: The outlet may have a local override. Remove the override if the outlet should inherit the master price again.

question: Why can't an outlet edit something?
answer: HQ outlet policy may block that action. Ask the HQ owner/admin to check the outlet policy in Locations.

question: How do I add a staff member?
answer: Go to Users, add the person, choose a role, and save. If they do not have email, share the Staff ID and temporary passcode shown once.

question: My payment failed. What happens now?
answer: Open Billing and retry payment if available. A past-due subscription can have a seven-day recovery period when its recovery timestamp is valid; if the UI cannot confirm that period, contact support.
source_note: Escalation-gated billing topic; do not invent a countdown.

question: What are enhancement packs?
answer: Enhancement packs give extra menu image, description, translation, and image editing capacity when a business needs more than the plan includes.

question: Can Answerlattice delete my MenuList data?
answer: Answerlattice should not process deletion requests directly. Contact MenuList support so the request can be handled through the approved privacy/data process.

question: Can you set up my custom domain?
answer: Custom domain setup needs support and DNS handling. Share the requested domain through support; Answerlattice should not invent DNS values.

question: What is included in MenuList features?
answer: MenuList covers intake, owner review, public menu, Official Business Page, QR/link sharing, Menu Kit, digital screens, theme controls, analytics, quality signals, roles, locations, and operational support surfaces depending on plan/account state.
source_note: Summarizes live features page; account-specific availability must be checked.

question: Can MenuList generate descriptions or images?
answer: Where the plan and enhancement balance allow, MenuList can prepare descriptions, images, translations, and edits from menu data for owner review.

question: Can I export a PDF?
answer: MenuList can generate a clean PDF from current menu data where the surface is available. Owners should verify the PDF before printing or sharing.

question: What is the Menu Presence checklist?
answer: It shows where the menu is visible, such as Google Business, Instagram, WhatsApp, QR, screens, and feedback, and helps the owner mark surfaces as added.
source_note: Checklist only; not a ranking guarantee.

question: What are customer message templates?
answer: They are ready-to-send messages with menu link, address, and hours for WhatsApp, SMS, or staff replies.
source_note: From repo helpdoc and live features page.

question: How does Special Menu Switching work?
answer: Owners can schedule a temporary festival, event, seasonal, or special menu. The regular menu returns automatically when the special period ends.
source_note: Feature may be account/flag-sensitive; verify before activation claims.

question: Can a connected system overwrite MenuList through External Menu Sync?
answer: No. External Menu Sync sends approved MenuList updates outward to a connected provider or developer URL. MenuList remains the official source, and connected systems do not write menu truth back through this flow.
source_note: High-risk integration boundary; verify the current account and connection state.

question: What does MenuList analytics collect?
answer: MenuList focuses on menu and action signals such as sessions, searches, top items, category interest, and action clicks, without customer names, emails, payment details, scroll heatmaps, hover tracking, or exact GPS in that analytics flow.
source_note: Grounded in live Features and Trust pages.

question: Does MenuList store card details?
answer: No. The public site says Razorpay processes payments and MenuList does not store card details.

question: Are refunds available?
answer: Fees and credit packs are generally final after the billing cycle or value delivery begins, subject to applicable law and confirmed billing errors. Account-specific disputes must go to support.
source_note: Policy-sensitive; do not promise or deny a specific refund.

question: Who owns uploaded and generated content?
answer: The business retains rights it already holds in uploaded content. Generated outputs may be used subject to applicable law, input rights, and relevant provider terms, and must be reviewed before publishing.

question: Why does MenuList say my upload looks like a different menu?
answer: MenuList may warn when uploaded files look like the wrong business, outlet, special menu, non-menu pages, or an incomplete menu. Continue only if the owner confirms the upload is correct.

question: What happens if my upload includes extra non-menu pages?
answer: MenuList can process the pages that look like menu pages and ignore unrelated pages. The owner should review the prepared menu before publishing.

question: What is Use MenuList?
answer: Use MenuList is the rollout surface where owners copy menu links, get screen links, download print/Menu Kit assets, and place QR codes in the business.

question: Where should I place my QR codes?
answer: Use table, counter, entrance, and feedback QR placements where they fit the business flow. Test scans after printing and keep the QR connected to the approved menu link.

question: What is Staff Prompt?
answer: Staff Prompt is a simplified staff-facing menu reference for current prices, availability, popular items, descriptions, dietary notes, and tags. It is not a customer-facing public page.

question: Staff Prompt looks outdated. What should staff do?
answer: Refresh the page first. If access is blocked, check the staff member's role or ask the owner/manager to update access.

question: Why does the public menu show an offline screen instead of an old saved menu?
answer: MenuList avoids showing an old saved menu because prices, items, and availability may have changed. Customers should reconnect to load the latest live menu.

question: Can customers find items if they misspell them?
answer: Menu search can handle common spelling variations using the published menu information, but owners do not need to configure this separately.

question: Why is my open or closed badge wrong?
answer: Check working hours and timezone in Store Settings first. If the business is closed for an unscheduled reason, use the available temporary status or update hours temporarily.
source_note: Grounded in hours-holiday-accuracy and temp-status docs.

question: Will printed QR codes break if I rename a menu?
answer: MenuList is designed to preserve old menu links through stored slugs and redirects. If a printed QR stops working, check the active menu, route, custom domain, and support escalation path.

question: Why do I need to sign in before uploading or importing a menu?
answer: The current Create Menu flow keeps upload, link acquisition, extraction, review, claim, and publish tied to the authenticated owner and selected business.

question: What is AI Menu Manager?
answer: AI Menu Manager answers selected-menu questions and prepares supported proposal cards. You review and approve required changes before MenuList uses the registered menu action.
source_note: Do not describe it as an autonomous chatbot.

question: Can AI Menu Manager change my menu without approval?
answer: No for approval-required work. Provider planning cannot directly mutate menu truth, and stale proposals fail if the menu changed after preparation.

question: How many credits does a description rewrite use?
answer: A description rewrite currently uses 1 content credit. MenuList shows the required credits before eligible work.
source_note: Current public credit policy; revalidate if the shared policy changes.

question: How many credits does a generated menu image use?
answer: A generated menu image currently uses 5 content credits. Prompt-cache hits are zero-credit, and only valid successful output settles paid generation.

question: How many credits does adding a language use?
answer: A language-addition request currently uses 3 content credits. Work can be recorded per request or batch, so one owner gesture may require more than one operation.
source_note: Current public credit policy; explain request-level accounting.

question: Do I lose credits if generated content fails?
answer: Paid work reserves credits before provider work. A terminal failure restores the exact reserved credit buckets once; if Transactions does not reconcile, contact support.
source_note: Credit reservation, settlement, and restoration boundary.

question: Why does Transactions show an AI operation?
answer: Transactions shows the owner-safe operation status and credit effect. It does not expose raw prompts, generated response bodies, provider cost, or internal model/accounting details.

question: Can MenuList publish generated descriptions, translations, or images automatically?
answer: No. Generated output is prepared for owner review and must be accepted and saved through the owning menu or business flow before it becomes public truth.

question: What is the difference between Business Health and Menu Manager?
answer: Business Health explains what is happening from read-only health and analytics context. Menu Manager prepares supported changes through proposal, approval, and receipt flows.
source_note: Keep read-only and action boundaries separate.

question: Why is my setup progress still open?
answer: Setup progress uses the currently loaded selected menu, required details, publication, and link-placement evidence. Optional descriptions, images, languages, and profile improvements do not keep the required card open after completion.

question: Can MenuList close automatically for public holidays?
answer: No holiday calendar or date-specific exception manager is currently shipped. Use Temporary Status or update today's hours for a one-off closure.

question: How does MenuList choose the Open or Closed status?
answer: It uses the selected location's validated weekly hours and business timezone. Overnight ranges are handled by the shared hours boundary.

question: Why is my owner dashboard in the wrong language or direction?
answer: Check the owner language and selected store. Owner desktop and mobile share the normalized locale and RTL boundary; contact support if the saved setting is correct but the surface remains wrong.

question: Why is the customer menu text in one language but buttons in English?
answer: Menu content can use more languages than fixed customer UI packs. When a content language has no dedicated UI pack, the approved content stays in that language while fixed buttons may fall back to English.
source_note: Public content vs fixed chrome boundary.

question: Does switching the owner dashboard language translate my menu?
answer: No. Owner UI language, the store's public customer language, and owner-entered menu translations are separate settings and workflows.

question: Can I use MenuList fully offline as an owner?
answer: No. Connectivity status is advisory, but current private owner truth and saves require a connection. MenuList does not treat stale private pages as a complete offline dashboard.

question: What should I do when MenuList says an update is ready?
answer: Use the explicit refresh/update action when you are ready. MenuList does not silently replace the running owner app.

question: Does giving someone Owner role transfer the business account?
answer: No. Owner role grants operational permissions but does not transfer billing records, notifications, subscriptions, or business-account authority. Complete transfer requires verified support review.

question: Can I download a complete account export from Projects?
answer: No. Menu/project downloads are not a complete account export. Full access, correction, portability, or deletion requests use verified support.

question: Can MenuList merge two locations that have the same name or phone number?
answer: No. Similar names or phone numbers do not authorize an automatic merge. Each location remains exact and reviewable.

question: Does adding a Google Maps link confirm the Google Place ID?
answer: No. A Maps URI alone does not prove a stable Place ID. A confirmed external ID needs attributable evidence and separate owner confirmation for the exact location.

question: Does Menu Presence prove my link is live on Google or Instagram?
answer: No. Menu Presence records readiness and owner confirmations. It is a checklist, not external-provider verification or a ranking guarantee.

question: Can MenuList post replies to reviews automatically?
answer: No. Reviews/Reputation and AI Reply Assist are currently disabled, and MenuList does not promise direct external review posting.

question: Is the owner referral reward available to everyone?
answer: No. Owner Referral remains disabled outside an explicitly approved pilot and allowlist. Do not promise invitations or rewards unless the current account visibly has the active flow.

question: Can AI publish allergen information from my uploaded menu?
answer: No. AI may help prepare source material, but allergen, ingredient, dietary, price, and availability assertions require responsible owner review and cannot be auto-published as verified truth.
